author: Inside Edition
description: These animals cause chaos. In 2022, A bull escaped from a truck transporting him to a slaughterhouse and wreaked havoc on the streets of Lima, Peru. In 2022, a squirrel ended up in a family's Christmas tree, and the video looked like a scene from "National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation." In 2023, railway employees in the Netherlands worked to remove badgers because the dens they dug and built underneath a major rail line caused havoc for thousands of travelers. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: These Animals Caused Chaos
